integrity: All-order proof by exact character sums, signed powers-of-two classification and exact count; two independent finite arithmetic checkers support the computations.
scientific_limitations: Three colours on complete bipartite graphs only; general weighted-colouring encodings may implicitly contain the multiplier formula; nonzero value distribution and sharp gap are not determined.
title: Parity-rigid ternary Fourier recovery on all complete bipartite graphs
